Motorized Shades in Los Angeles, California

Adjust a tall window without reaching for it, or lower several shades together when the afternoon light changes. John and Max help you choose compatible motorized shades, install them and set up the controls. Visit our Woodland Hills showroom or call to discuss your rooms.

Discuss motorization(818) 884-5464
Alta

Choose controls you'll want to use

Some customers like using an app. Others want a handheld remote or a control on the wall. We'll ask how you want to operate the shades and show you the options for the system you're considering.

You may want to adjust one shade at a time, operate several together or connect them to a smart-home system. The product and equipment determine which features are available, so we check those details before recommending a system.

Hunter Douglas PowerView® Automation

PowerView® Automation operates compatible Hunter Douglas window treatments. We can help you compare the available products, remotes and app controls, along with any hub or gateway needed for the features you want.

If you'd like the shades to move at set times, we can discuss schedules in the PowerView® App. We'll show you how the selected system works and help you set up the controls at installation.

The PowerView® App is required for programmed operation.

Somfy motorization

We also work with Somfy motorization on compatible window treatments. Depending on the motor and controls, options can include a handheld remote, a wall control and app access through compatible equipment.

If you're adding to motorized treatments you already own, let us know what equipment you have. We check the motor, controls and connected equipment together before recommending an addition.

Plan the power supply before the order

Power choices depend on the product. Available options may include replaceable batteries, rechargeable power or a wired connection. For a tall window, the way you reach a battery or charger matters just as much as the control you choose.

For a new build or remodel, involve us while the wiring and window details can still be coordinated. If electrical work is needed, we can discuss the shade requirements with your electrician.

A motorization job in Santa Rosa Valley

On a new-build project in Santa Rosa Valley, one of the connections for the hardwired shades wasn't working after the walls had been finished. We coordinated with an electrician to resolve the wiring issue, then completed the shade and app setup.

It is one reason we like to be involved early in a project. We install and set up the window treatments, with electrical work handled by the electrician.

Help after the shades are installed

We'll show you how to use the controls before we finish. If something stops responding later, contact us and describe what's happening. Some questions can be worked through over the phone; others need a closer look.

John has helped customers recalibrate a shade through the app without needing a visit. What we can do depends on the system and the problem, so we'll work through that with you.

Questions about motorized window treatments

Ask John and Max: (818) 884-5464
Can you motorize shades I already have?

Sometimes. The product, age, condition and available components determine what's possible. Send us the brand and model if you know them, along with photos, so we can review the options.

Will it work with my existing smart-home system?

Compatibility depends on the motor, controls, generation and connected equipment. Tell us which system you use and we'll check the requirements. We don't assume every motorized product works with every platform.

Can I keep a remote as well as an app?

Many systems support more than one control method. We'll confirm the combination available for your shades and show you how to use it.

Talk with John and Max about motorization

Tell us which windows you'd like to operate more easily and whether you're starting with new shades or reviewing an existing system. We'll help you work through the product, controls, installation and setup.
